g.text: 2. Source / changes: Codex custom ASIC interface. V8 FPGA-side pin remap (Howard approved 2 Nov 2026): ASIC groups moved to the bank nearest their connector, each returned clock on a clock-capable pin; Vivado check pending. V11 change (Howard approved 2 Nov 2026): J1/J2 DF40C-60DS to DF40C-70DS and contact map changed and reordered within each ASIC group except ASIC1, FPGA pins unchanged, because the header corner contacts are not energized: Hirose DF40 catalog Jun 2024 p.8 and p.14 Note 3, guideline ETAD-H1015-00 sec 1.2.1, https://www.hirose.com/en/product/series/DF40.

Source / changes: Trenz TE0714-04-42I-7-L REV04 p6:125MHz LVDS U2, L1 ferrite, C10=470nF, R1=100R and C134/C135=100nF coupling. https://www.trenz-electronic.de/trenzdownloads/Trenz_Electronic/Modules_and_Module_Carriers/3x4/TE0714/REV04/Documents/SCH-TE0714-04-42I-7-L.PDF Adapted by Codex: Y1=AX3DAF1-125.0000T3 (exact Trenz oscillator MPN undisclosed), C80=470nF, C81 10uF->100nF; added L4. External R56 removed per UG482 Fig. 5-8 p226 (100nF caps only); with it, AX3 swing is 250-450mV against DS181 350mV minimum.
